step1_analysis.description: A high-speed, continuous-time current comparator used for current-mode PWM control in a DC-DC converter. It features a low-impedance self-biased input stage with cross-coupled positive feedback to provide high transimpedance gain, followed by a differential-to-single-ended amplifier and digital output inverters.

paper_reference.title: A Monolithic Current-Mode CMOS DC–DC Converter With On-Chip Current-Sensing Technique

Power_Consumption.description: Total DC power dissipation of the comparator.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on square-law calculations for SKY130 parameters with W/L=10.

Propagation_Delay.description: Time delay from the input current crossing zero to the output voltage crossing VDD/2.

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the parasitic capacitance at N5 and the charging current. With 10uA input step, delay should be in the tens of nanoseconds.
sky130_expected.reasoning: SKY130 is a 130nm process, much faster than the original 0.6um, so delays < 50ns are expected.

Input_Impedance.description: Small-signal input impedance at the current input nodes.

sky130_expected.calculation: The cross-coupled NMOS pair cancels the diode-connected NMOS resistance, leaving only the rds of the transistors. Zin ≈ rds / 2 ≈ 1 MOhm = 120 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Perfect cancellation is limited by channel length modulation (lambda).

Transimpedance_Gain.description: Gain from input current difference to the pre-inverter voltage node (N5).

sky130_expected.calculation: Zin * Av_diff = 1 MOhm * 125 V/V = 125 MOhm = 162 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper's 20 dB might refer to a different loop gain, but the internal transimpedance of this comparator is extremely high due to the active positive feedback.

Operating_Frequency.description: Maximum switching frequency supported by the comparator.

sky130_expected.reasoning: SKY130 can easily support >10MHz for this topology, far exceeding the 1MHz reported for the 0.6um design.
Adapted from the paper's 5.2V to the modern 1.8V process.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, input impedance, transimpedance gain, and propagation delay of the current comparator.
